source: notebooks/colab/normalised/normalised_metacognition.ipynb, executed in Colab. Values copied from its printed output in results/normalised_output.txt; the figure is results/figures/normalised.png.

replay_scores.unnormalised: s = X X^T a, raw embeddings (as the paper writes F(a))
replay_scores.normalised: s = Xn Xn^T a, each embedding scaled to length 1 inside F(a) only

notes: Both arms use the same embeddings, decay rates and parameters, and the seed is reset before each arm, so their replay coin flips are identical (154 replay events each).

The seed is reset after the decay rates are drawn, so the coin flips start four draws earlier than in the notebook. That is why the unnormalised arm ends at 0.146975 here, against 0.137944 in the notebook and the replay-tracking run.
